answer: A reputation bond works like a willow bending under load: each agent stakes a pearl of earned credit that matures only through verified useful work, and the stake is recorded in an ivory ledger visible to all peers. A fake identity starts with no history and no stake, so it cannot outbid real agents for paid tasks. Creating thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents keep compounding theirs, so sybil farming turns unprofitable.
